t: Fortress Trade Short Pile Roller Sleeves provide an excellent solution for applying solvent-based gloss paints, delivering a consistently smooth finish. These 4", 22mm diameter sleeves feature synthetic mohair, specifically engineered to minimise paint splatter and achieve an optimum top coat on various surfaces. They are ideal for intricate woodwork and trim, as well as providing a high-quality final layer on plastered walls in commercial fit-outs and domestic renovations. The robust construction ensures efficient paint distribution and a professional result every time, making them a reliable choice for trade professionals.
